title: Descent of finite-free beta pullback from K-flat representatives
statement: Descent of finite-free beta pullback from K-flat representatives

proof.text: For fixed X, Y and f, package the scalar-first composite as a natural transformation alpha by whiskering beta, the inverse restriction/pullback comparison, and inverse theta. Package tensorPull as a natural transformation tau by composing the inverse exact-pullback comparison, leftDerivedTensorComparison, and the tensor of the forward exact-pullback comparison. Compose tau with the tensor of modelPull and the identity, then beta, to obtain rho. Their components are definitionally the two morphisms in the statement.

Apply CochainComplex.exists_quasiIso_flat_kFlat to Q.objPreimage K. For its quasi-isomorphism p:P to Q.objPreimage K, localization gives the isomorphism i=asIso(Q.map p) followed by Q.objObjPreimageIso K from Q.obj P to K. The provided hrep gives alpha.app(Q.obj P)=rho.app(Q.obj P).

Precompose the desired equality with the image of i.hom under tensorLeft B followed by pullback. This image is an isomorphism, hence an epimorphism. Naturality of alpha and rho rewrites both composites as their components at Q.obj P followed by the same target image of i.hom. Substitute the representative equality and cancel the epimorphism.

theorem finiteFreeScalarDerivedComparison_beta_pullback_of_kflat
    (D : ScalarSixPullbackData.{u}) {Λ Λ' : ScalarSixRing.{u}}
    (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') (S : ShortComplex (PointModules Λ))
    (t : S.X₃ ≅ (Mod.comap a.hom.hom).obj (Mod.regular Λ'.X))
    (β : ∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, tensorLeft (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (complex Λ S Z)) ≅
      scalarSixChange a Z ⋙ restriction a Z)
    (hβ : ∀ Z, AugmentationNormalized a S t Z (β Z))
    (hrep : ∀ (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Y)
      (C : CochainComplex (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules Λ.X Y) ℤ),
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat C →
      (scalarSixPull Λ f).map ((β Y).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)) ≫
        (derivedComapUpperStarIso (Λ := Λ.X) (Λ' := Λ'.X) a.hom.hom f).inv.app
          ((scalarSixChange a Y).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)) ≫
        (restriction a X).map ((D.theta a f).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)) =
      tensorPull Λ f (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (complex Λ S Y)) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) ≫
        ((modelPull Λ S f).hom ⊗ₘ 𝟙 ((scalarSixPull Λ f).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C))) ≫
        (β X).hom.app ((scalarSixPull Λ f).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C))) :
    ∀ (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Y)
      (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules Λ.X Y)),
      (scalarSixPull Λ f).map ((β Y).hom.app K) ≫
        (derivedComapUpperStarIso (Λ := Λ.X) (Λ' := Λ'.X) a.hom.hom f).inv.app
          ((scalarSixChange a Y).obj K) ≫
        (restriction a X).map ((D.theta a f).inv.app K) =
      tensorPull Λ f (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (complex Λ S Y)) K ≫
        ((modelPull Λ S f).hom ⊗ₘ 𝟙 ((scalarSixPull Λ f).obj K)) ≫
        (β X).hom.app ((scalarSixPull Λ f).obj K)
